description: Cheapest LLM tier that can answer a request well: small, medium or frontier

tier.instructions: Which model tier does this request need to be answered well?

criteria.small: greeting, simple fact, short translation, grammar fix, simple classification or extraction
criteria.medium: ordinary writing, summarizing, explaining, or routine code in a familiar pattern
criteria.frontier: multi-step reasoning, math, hard or unfamiliar code, research, or high-stakes advice
